_comment: Expected dimension ranges for engine.Compute(template=classic, format=png) against the mocked octocat GraphQL fixture. The values are an envelope, not a target — width_min guards the 480px canvas width (SC-001); the height bounds catch a 1x1 placeholder leaking through (lower) and accidental layout explosions (upper). After #602 the header is a regular plugin and the test enables only plugin_header, so the card is just the identity block (~130-180px); upper bound retained at 9000 for layout-explosion regressions.
